scope: Owner-free official municipal tax-sale sources suitable for NS Marks The Spot research
privacyRule: Never store or publish assessed-owner, successful-bidder, tenant or occupant names.

extractionNotes: The official list contains an assessed-name column; discard it before writing any source file.
One lien contains two PIDs, producing 68 PIDs from 67 rows.
Use the map-and-descriptions PDF only to visually reconcile public parcel fields; do not republish its document pages.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Pictou
extractionNotes: The official PDF contains owner names; discard them before writing any source file.
Three rows are marked no longer part of the sale and must remain withdrawn, not active.
PDF text extraction drops leading zeroes from at least two PIDs; visually verify every PID against the rendered page and store it as an eight-character string.
This event is historical and must be off by default in an upcoming-sales view.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Richmond
extractionNotes: The official results table includes assessed-owner and successful-bidder names; discard both.
Label these three records as historical sold results, never as currently available parcels.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Annapolis
extractionNotes: The current result pages embed their tables as images.
Do not map OCR output until every PID and row status is visually checked against the official image.

events.municipality: Municipality of the County of Kings
extractionNotes: The current page confirms the event but exposes no parcel table suitable for the map.
Do not invent parcel rows from the event notice.

events.municipality: Municipality of the District of Chester
extractionNotes: The municipality explicitly states that it is not holding a 2026 tax sale.
Show this only in a municipality-status view; create no parcel records.
